What am I looking at?

A simplified electrical model built from the female FlyWire v783 connectome. Sugar switches artificial stimulation of 21 sensory neurons on or off. The body and its glow illustrate anatomy and aggregate activity; they do not simulate walking or feeding. This is not a complete biological fly.

The brain runs separately from the graphics. If computation slows, simulated time advances more slowly while the view stays responsive.
